title: Represent exact source values for bounded source-obligation proofs
description:
Extend bounded source-obligation/discharge proofs where shape-only evidence cannot
establish a source-fidelity or selected-capability claim. Support exact source-derived
values and relations such as typed scalars, units, dice, abilities, quantities, timing,
and inter-facet relationships. This is not a requirement to convert every source value
into a closed semantic ontology.
acceptance_criteria:
- Declared bounded obligations can express exact source-derived values/relations with source anchors and drift detection.
- Wrong ability/DC, damage amount/type, target count, duration/reset value, or transition payload is detectable where included in the declared obligation.
- Caller options and projection output cannot be sole authority for the value being proved.
- The mechanism does not assert corpus-wide source-value completeness or infer absence outside declared obligations.
